# Spotlight FX

> > Professional video templates and motion graphics for Adobe After Effects and Premiere Pro, designed for content creators and video editors.

Spotlight FX offers a curated collection of one-click import templates including text animations, light leaks, transitions, and overlays. The site also provides tutorials and guides for video editing workflows in Premiere Pro and After Effects.

## Key Topics

- After Effects templates
- Premiere Pro templates
- Text animations
- Motion graphics
- Light leak overlays
- Video transitions
- One-click import
- YouTube editing
- Film burn effects
- Cinematic overlays
- Video workflow automation
- 3D motion effects
- Device mockup frames
- J-cuts and L-cuts
- Premiere Pro 2025

## Premiere Pro Templates

- [Film Burn Vintage Frame Overlay for Premiere Pro](https://spotlightfx.com/premiere-pro/templates/film-burn-vintage-frame-overlay-with-sprocket-holes-and-red-light-leak): Retro 35mm film overlay with sprocket holes for Premiere Pro
- [Dynamic Slide Text Animation for Premiere Pro](https://spotlightfx.com/premiere-pro/templates/dynamic-slide-text-animation-for-channel-intros): Channel intro text animation with purple overlay for YouTubers
- [Gradient Background Overlay with Smooth Fade for Premiere Pro](https://spotlightfx.com/premiere-pro/templates/bottom-gradient-background-element-with-smooth-fade): Cinematic gradient background overlay with smooth fade effect
- [Wedding Quote Slide Text Template for Premiere Pro](https://spotlightfx.com/premiere-pro/templates/quote-3-line-slide): Three-line romantic quote template with fade for weddings
- [Center Slide Up Arrow Text List for Premiere Pro](https://spotlightfx.com/premiere-pro/templates/vertical-center-text-slider-with-arrow-indicator-where-each-word-slides-up-and-pauses-in-the-middle): Vertical text slider with arrow indicator for menu presentations
- [Slide Down Mid Element for Premiere Pro](https://spotlightfx.com/premiere-pro/templates/dynamic-slide-down-mid-element-with-bold-contrast): Bold black-white contrast slide down element for video backgrounds

## After Effects Templates

- [Light Leak Film Burn Transition for After Effects](https://spotlightfx.com/after-effects/templates/light-leak-film-burn-transition-with-horizontal-warm-fade): Vintage film burn transition template with warm fade for After Effects
- [Dynamic 3D Look Zoom Effect for After Effects](https://spotlightfx.com/after-effects/templates/3d-look-zoom-in-tilt-element-with-dynamic-motion): 3D zoom and tilt motion template for tech videos and intros
- [Bold Promo Reveal Text Animation for After Effects](https://spotlightfx.com/after-effects/templates/dynamic-promo-reveal-text-animation-with-bold-style): Bold text reveal animation for promotional video intros
- [Flat Smartphone Punch Hole Frame Overlay for After Effects](https://spotlightfx.com/after-effects/templates/device-frame-smartphone-flat-edge): Smartphone mockup frame with punch hole for After Effects
- [Cyan Chevron Light Leak Overlay for After Effects](https://spotlightfx.com/after-effects/templates/cyan-chevron-bokeh-light-leak-overlay-with-vertical-streaks-for-dynamic-urban-shots): Geometric cyan light leak overlay for urban video scenes
- [Red Glow Horror Text Opener for After Effects](https://spotlightfx.com/after-effects/templates/horror-themed-text-opener-with-red-glow-effect): Horror-themed text opener with red glow for spooky intros
- [Center Slide Up Highlight Text List for After Effects](https://spotlightfx.com/after-effects/templates/vertical-center-text-slider-on-dark-background-where-each-word-slides-up-and-highlights-in-the-middle): Vertical text slider with center highlight effect for After Effects
